scripts.mobile:android: cd frontend && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: cd frontend && npx cap open ios
scripts.mobile:build-android: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.mobile:build-ios: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release archive
